# podinfo

podinfo, a small routed workload for proving a cluster serves traffic.

| image | string | `"ghcr.io/stefanprodan/podinfo:6.7.1"` | Container image. Tag-pinned here; the lab renderer's image lock rewrites this to a digest, and that machinery is lab-scope so the staged cluster does not get it.  |
